answer_1.quote: We propose LexGen, an approach to address the task of generating domain-specific dictionaries under a limited supervision setting. Our objective is to generate translations in zero-shot and few-shot settings from English to six Indic languages...
answer_1.outputs: generated target-language dictionary entries (translations) for English source terms

answer_2.quote: We use ChrF++ metric for the dictionary generation task... Following BLI literature, we also report P@1 scores for all our experiments.

answer_4.quote: We extend the IDDT experiment... We provide the top three predictions generated by our model to the expert annotators and ask them to select valid translation(s). If there are multiple translations for a phrase, we ask annotators to provide a preference order for the translations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators select the valid translation(s) among the top three predictions and rank them by preference when multiple are correct.
